name: Bazil tells his version

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: In the Stockades, Bazil Thredd describes the Stonemasons’ work as unpaid and cheated, then recounts the riot and VanCleef’s leadership. His account is evidence of what Bazil says, not a neutral verdict on every detail. The prison’s close stone and iron make the testimony feel contained, while the grievance reaches back to the rebuilt city.
